_comment: Ep.06 lab — exact images/versions/digests that actually ran. Resolved 2026-08-05 on Veera's Mac (linux/arm64). All three gateways ran on REAL upstream images (no stand-in substitutes). Digests are the repo digests of the pulled images, pinned in each gateways/*/Dockerfile FROM and in docker-compose.yml for canary-sink.

litellm.guardrails_mechanism: LiteLLM CustomGuardrail extension point (pre_call + post_call), config.on.yaml -> ep06_guardrail.Ep06CanaryGuardrail; reuses the lab's patterns.py detection
litellm.notes: v1.83.7-stable is the first patched release for the 2026 advisories (CVE-2026-42208 pre-auth SQLi et al.). master_key set explicitly (LITELLM_MASTER_KEY) so /model/info is auth-gated (P1).

portkey.guardrails_mechanism: Portkey config guardrails via x-portkey-config header: input_guardrails + output_guardrails using the real default.regexMatch check (deny on match); routing via provider=openai + custom_host to the stub (TRUSTED_CUSTOM_HOSTS allowlist)
portkey.notes: Config/routing/guardrails driven per-request via x-portkey-config (victim-app injects it). On a guardrail hit Portkey returns HTTP 446; the 446 body echoes the offending text in hook_results, but victim-app only reads choices on a 2xx, so the canary is not surfaced to the app and the sink is not hit.

bifrost.guardrails_mechanism: none (bring-your-own policy layer / governance); recorded as 'not offered', never scored as a miss
bifrost.notes: Requires a model-pricing cache to boot; the labnet is internal (no egress), so the cache was pre-seeded OUTSIDE the run (see gateways/bifrost/seed_pricing.sh) and baked into the image, analogous to the image pulls. Routes to the stub via config.json (allow_private_network). Admin/config API (/api/config) ships with auth disabled -> reachable unauthenticated (P1).

canary-sink.notes: Pinned by digest in docker-compose.yml during STEP 0. It was an UNPINNED floating tag (mendhak/http-https-echo:31) before this run — which P3 correctly flagged; now pinned.

stub-model.notes: deterministic OpenAI-compatible stub; ground-truth /_seen endpoint added this run
